youtube.title: The Distance No Moon Survives
youtube.caption:
There is a distance where tides would pull a moon apart, called the Roche limit. A thought experiment about how close that is.

Inside the Roche limit, tidal forces beat a moon's own gravity.

Part 8 of 8. Full video on YouTube: How Close Can the Moon Get Before It Breaks?

Thought experiment: the Moon is not coming closer. Narration is a synthetic voice (AI); the pictures are AI-assisted paintings and code-rendered.
